verdict.rationale: n8n runs a public workflow template gallery at n8n.io/workflows, advertised as over 12,000 community automation workflows, and its GitHub README cites 9,000+ workflow templates. That clearly delivers a public starting library rather than building from scratch. missing for 10: documentation of how a template is imported or used as a starting point in the editor, independent hands-on corroboration of template quality and usability for ops tasks.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can start from a public library of workflow templates instead of building from scratch

citations.quote: Discover 12116 Automation Workflows from the n8n's Community
1500+ integrations and 9,000+ workflow templates to connect AI with your existing systems
